objective: Renewable energy use in district heating
indicator: share of renewables in heating and cooling network
description:
The German Federal Government intends to achieve a further increase in the share of renewables in heating and cooling networks. 
According to the recast Renewable Energy Directive, the EU Member States shall endeavor to increase the share of renewable energy from waste heat and cold in district heating networks by 2,2 percentage points as an annual average for the period between 2021 and 2030. This ambitious goal is also enshrined in the NECP. 
The progress indicator does not yet include the share of energy from waste heat and cold.

indicator: Energia termica da rinnovabili nel teleriscaldamento
description:
Renewable energy use in disctrict heating: 
Nello scenario di policy del PNIEC inviato alla Commissione nel 2020 è stimato che il contributo dell'energia termica da rinnovabili immessa in reti di teleriscaldamento possa raggiungere gli 0.36 Mtep nel 2030 (non è però assolutamente da considerarsi come un obiettivo, è una stima di scenario soggetta ad aggiornamento). 
Nell'aggiornamento del PNIEC non si è fissato un obiettivo specifico relativo all'energia termica da rinnovabili immessa in reti di teleriscaldamento.

objective: Renewable energy communities
description:
Nel PNIEC è richiamata l'importanza del sostegno alla diffusione delle configurazioni in autoconsumo e delle comunità energetiche rinnovabili, al fine di promuovere un sistema elettrico più decentrato e un ruolo attivo della domanda e della produzione distribuita. 
Il sostegno alle configurazioni di autoconsumo collettivo e alle comunità energetiche rinnovabili è attuato attraverso provvedimenti normativi di incentivazione.

Other national objective and trajectory, including sectoral and long term - 1
indicator: Share of RES and lowcarbon gases
description: Share of renewable and lowcarbon gases (biomethane, hydrogen and other synthetic gases)

objective: Other national objective and trajectory, including sectoral and long term - 2
target_text: An indicative objective of 0.1 percent, in energy content, of advanced biofuels and biogas in the years 2020 and 2021 and a minimum obligatory objectives of 0.2 percent in 2022, 0.3 percent in 2023, 0.5 percent in 2024, 1 percent in 2025, 1.2 percent in 2026 and 3.5 percent in 2030, all of them in energy content, for each of the obligated subjects to prove compliance with the objectives of sale or consumption of biofuels and biogas for transport purposes.
indicator: Percentage of sale or consumption of advanced biofuels and biogas in transport reached in year X
description: Royal Decree 376/2022 regulates the annual targets for the penetration of renewable gases in the sale or consumption of natural gas for the transport sector up to 2030.

objective: Other national objective and trajectory, including sectoral and long term - 3
target_text:
A limit of biofuels produced from food and feed crops of 3,5% (2023), 3% (2024) and 2,6% (2025).
From 2026 on, and as long as no additional limits are established, the limit of biofuels produced from food and fodder crops for the purposes of the objective of biofuels and biogas for transport purposes applicable to the year 2025 will be understood extended.
indicator: Percentage of sale or consumption of biofuels from food and feed crops in transport reached in year X.
description: Order TED/1342/2022, of December 23, which establishes the limit of biofuels produced from food and feed crops for the purposes of the objective of sale or consumption of biofuels and biogas for transport purposes.

objective: Other national objective and trajectory, including sectoral and long term - 1
target_text:
The entities under obligation of sale or consumption of biofuels must annually prove to the certifying entity the ownership of a minimum number of biofuel certificates that allow the objectives to be met regulated in Royal Decree 1085/2015, of December 4, for the promotion of biofuels or regulation that replaces it.
For the years up to 2026, the biofuel target trajectory in annual calculation will be: 8,5% (2020), 9.5% (2021), 10% (2022), 10,5% (2023), 11% (2024), 11,5% (2025) and 12% (2026).
indicator: Percentage of sale or consumption of biofuels in transport reached in year X.
description: Royal Decree 376/2022 regulates the targets for the sale or consumption of biofuels as the percentages of sales or consumption of biofuels over the total gasoline and diesel sold or consumed, for transport purposes up to 2026.
